analysis.title: GS Duttenhoefer - Duttenhoefer's Daily 06.10.2026
key_insights: Market close recap: S&P 500 +66bps to 7774 (+13.6% ytd) on low volumes. Nasdaq +1% to another all-time high. Semis up 5 weeks in a row. US 10yr higher at 5.32%, Brent $101, Gold $4121, Bitcoin $85.5k.
Goldman's view on the Fed: an October hike is unlikely, and there is a strong chance the FOMC concludes additional hikes are unnecessary.

Q3 earnings preview: consensus expects S&P 500 y/y EPS growth of 27%. AI infrastructure spending accounts for over 50% of S&P 500 EPS growth this quarter, alongside hyperscaler capex growth of 116%. Median S&P stock EPS growth is about 9%, vs 14% in Q2.

Earnings concentration: the top 10 contributing stocks are expected to account for 68% of aggregate S&P 500 earnings growth in 3Q26, vs 48% in 2Q26. Micron and Nvidia together account for 34% of index growth.
GS economists estimate higher rates subtract about 0.2% from 2027 GDP growth. The estimate sums the effects on housing, consumption and capex, the three most rate-sensitive GDP components.

TSMC earnings preview: decent 3Q26 numbers expected. GS raises its 2027E US$ revenue growth forecast to 36.9% y/y from 32.0%, citing AI accelerator and networking demand and a stronger server CPU contribution.

US semis preview: GS sees upside to estimates across most sub-sectors. After a pullback over the past 2 months (SOX -11% vs SPX +4%), GS sees a more constructive trading setup than it did ahead of 2Q results.
Data center capacity: GS raises its 2026 US forecast by 5 GW to 64 GW and cuts its 2027 forecast by 5 GW to 90 GW. GS reads the 2027 cut as showing limited impact so far from political constraints.
Hyperscaler cloud revenue growth accelerated to 48% last quarter alongside surging backlogs. GS equity analysts anticipate a further acceleration to 55% in Q3.

European equities: EPS momentum is positive, and Europe's FCF yield is 5.5% vs 3.5% for the US. Buybacks continue, net equity supply is negative, and M&A is at highs. GS stays overweight Technology, Banks, Renewables, Defense and Capital intensive.
DeepSeek is close to securing at least $12bn in funding ahead of an IPO in early 2027. Contemporary Amperex and Tencent have committed among the largest amounts.

TikTok is launching an AI shopping assistant and in-app checkout. GS sees this as the start of agentic AI in commerce that could lift e-commerce penetration, while the threat environment from agentic payments may scale faster than legitimate autonomous commerce.

Other items: higher merger activity (Schneider, C.H. Robinson), Trump executive order to lower diesel prices, Brazil election results (Bolsonaro 47.0% vs Lula 45.2%), FOMC minutes due tomorrow, and a16z published a State of Markets presentation.

Hyperscaler cloud revenue growth was 48% last quarter (already reported). GS equity analysts forecast 55% in Q3.
